name: Fix OOM Plan
description: Eliminate recurring DuckDB OOMs in judgment-job unassessed counts and comparison-project serving rebuilds without raising DUCKDB_MEMORY_LIMIT as the primary fix.

userStories.title: Bound raw unassessed count fallback
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want `/api/judgmentsjobs-unassessed-count` to compute exact raw fallback counts in bounded article windows so the endpoint does not OOM when project marts are stale.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace the raw fallback path behind `getUnassessedCountFromDuckdb` so it does not run one full-scope `countDuckdbUnassessedArticles` aggregate for stale projects.
Use a mart-backed article candidate window that includes dirty article candidates and existing `mart.project_scope_article` rows for stale project state.
For each article window, query judged prompt ids or counts with `article_id IN (...)`, model/content settings, and project prompt ids, then accumulate an exact count in TypeScript.
Do not emit or execute `selected_scoped_article_import` for unassessed-count raw fallback when `hasDuplicateStudyRecords` and `hasStudyDecisionConflict` filters are absent.
When metadata filters are present, scope any selected import ranking to the current article batch rather than the full project scope.
Add tests for the failing count shape using job/project settings equivalent to `GET /api/judgmentsjobs-unassessed-count?jobId=dc227fc7-9760-420e-ad36-65149a16c850`.
`bun test src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.test.ts` passes
Targeted `bunx eslint` on changed files passes

userStories.title: Bound raw unassessed article preview
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want `/api/judgmentsjobs-unassessed-articles` to reuse bounded unassessed candidates so the preview endpoint does not scan the entire project before slicing one page.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace the raw fallback use of `getUnassessedArticleRows` for the judgment-job preview route with the bounded candidate window logic from the count fix.
Stop scanning after collecting `offset + limit` unassessed articles for the requested page.
Hydrate display fields only for the returned article ids.
Keep the serving-row path unchanged when fresh `mart.review_article_serving` rows exist.
Add tests proving raw preview does not enumerate all scoped articles before slicing.
`bun test src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.test.ts` passes
Targeted `bunx eslint` on changed files passes

userStories.title: Add comparison rebuild lease
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one active comparison serving rebuild per comparison project so duplicate route-triggered rebuilds do not interleave or delete each other's staged generation rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a per-comparison-project rebuild claim in `comparisonProjectServingRebuildService` or a sibling service.
Claim only when no fresh `refreshing` workflow exists for the same comparison project, or when the existing workflow is stale or expired.
Duplicate fire-and-forget route-triggered rebuilds return or skip without starting another memory-heavy workflow.
Progress updates refresh the claim at phase boundaries.
Failure cleanup deletes only the claimed generation and does not mark a newer claimed generation failed.
Add tests that two concurrent rebuild calls for one comparison project do not both build or promote the same generation.
`bun test src/server/services/comparisonProjectServingRebuildService.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/routes/ComparisonProjectsRoutes.rollback.test.ts` passes
Targeted `bunx eslint` on changed files passes

userStories.title: Narrow rebuild transaction boundaries
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want comparison serving rebuilds to keep only status and generation transitions transactional so DuckDB can release memory between bulk batch statements.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep `stageComparisonProjectServingGeneration`, status updates, promotion, and cleanup transactional.
Do not wrap full prompt cell, summary cell, or rollup phases in one transaction.
Record progress before and after each phase without requiring a long-lived transaction around bulk inserts.
Preserve inactive generation semantics so readers continue using the active generation until promotion.
Add tests proving bulk phases are invoked outside a single long transaction while status and promotion remain transactional.
`bun test src/server/services/comparisonProjectServingRebuildService.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/services/comparisonProjectServingRollupBuilder.test.ts` passes
Targeted `bunx eslint` on changed files passes

userStories.title: Batch comparison cell inserts
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want comparison serving cell creation to insert cells by article batch so prompt and summary cell phases cannot materialize the full project scope at once.
acceptanceCriteria: Add article batch discovery for comparison cell builds, similar to `getComparisonProjectArticleRollupBatch`.
Batch prompt-mode LLM cell inserts with a small `article_batch` CTE.
Batch prompt-mode human cell inserts with the same `article_batch` CTE.
Batch summary-mode LLM cell inserts with the same `article_batch` CTE.
Batch summary-mode human cell inserts with the same `article_batch` CTE.
Keep the default batch size safe for the 6400MiB maintenance-worker profile.
Add SQL tests showing each generated cell insert is constrained by `article_batch`.
`bun test src/server/services/comparisonProjectServingCellBuilder.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/services/comparisonProjectServingRebuildService.test.ts` passes
Targeted `bunx eslint` on changed files passes

userStories.title: Materialize comparison generation config
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want stable comparison column and model configuration materialized once per generation so batched cell and rollup statements do not repeat full-scope model discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract prompt order, content variants, selected or discovered model order, source project summary config, and required column ids from the current CTEs into compact generation-scoped state.
Use temporary tables inside the rebuild when they are safe across batched statements on one connection, otherwise add small mart tables with generation cleanup.
Do not add backward-compatible parallel paths for obsolete intermediate state.
Update cell and rollup builders to read the compact config instead of repeating full-scope model discovery in every batch.
Add tests that selected model order, discovered model order, prompt-mode columns, and summary-mode columns remain stable after materialization.
`bun test src/server/services/comparisonProjectServingCellBuilder.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/services/comparisonProjectServingRollupBuilder.test.ts` passes
`bun run db:mig` passes if a DuckDB migration is added

userStories.title: Review bounded-path indexes
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the new bounded unassessed and comparison rebuild queries to use appropriate DuckDB indexes without adding speculative indexes.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm the new bounded query paths can use existing indexes such as `idx_app_article_import_route_import_route_id` and `idx_app_project_article_article_id` where relevant.
Add a DuckDB migration for `app.article_import_route(article_id, import_route_id)` only if batch scoped import ranking needs article-first lookup.
Do not add indexes that are not exercised by the bounded paths.
If a migration is added, ensure stale/obsolete intermediate state is clearly cut over rather than supported in parallel.
